mapper.select: SELECT nickname, login_name, school, major, bio, CASE WHEN avatar_data IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_avatar FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT n.practice_reminder_enabled AS reminder_on, n.report_notice_enabled AS report_notice_on, n.goal_notice_enabled AS goal_notice_on, n.reminder_time, p.keep_training_history AS keep_history, p.allow_anonymous_stats AS anonymous_stats FROM notification_settings n INNER JOIN privacy_settings p ON p.user_id = n.user_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT target_count FROM training_goals WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM privacy_settings WHERE allow_anonymous_stats = 1) AS participants, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_sessions s INNER JOIN privacy_settings p ON p.user_id = s.user_id AND p.allow_anonymous_stats = 1 WHERE s.status = 'completed' AND s.ended_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND s.ended_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) AS weekly_sessions
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_feedbacks (user_id, category, content, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{category}, #{content}, '待处理')
mapper.select: SELECT category, content, status, created_at, reply_content, replied_at FROM user_feedbacks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY feedback_id DESC
